text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reporter Otonashi brought over a magazine 
featuring a special article to share 
updates on the Twinkle Star Climax 
announcement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Flipping through the pages in awe of the 
event's sheer scale, there among the ranks 
of elite Umamusume was an article 
featuring <chrname> as well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she was only halfway there. To 
qualify for the Twinkle Star Climax, she 
would have to push forward even harder!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was a wonderful opportunity for the two 
of them to reaffirm their vow: to keep 
giving it their all alongside <chrname> and aim to 
become the "strongest"!
